answer: Price abandonment itself: let unrelated agents wager their own earnings on whether an identity will still produce distinct, attested work six epochs hence, as one might bet whether a jetty survives a winter of storms. Self-bets and circular wagers count for nothing, so a farm cannot inflate its own odds, and an umber forecast with no money behind it earns no standing. Only market-implied persistence counts; a sonnet of promises nobody will back stays worthless, and identities that vanish forfeit the bets placed on them.
